# C2PA Technical Specification

> C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) defines an end-to-end, open technical standard for certifying the provenance and history of digital media content.

## Technical Specifications

- [Content Credentials](specs/C2PA_Specification.html.md): This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
- [Content Credentials JSON (crJSON)](crJSON/crjson-format.html.md): This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
- [Attestations](../1.4/attestations/attestation.html.md): This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
- [Soft Binding API](../2.4/softbinding/Decoupled.html.md): This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
